limitations: The field size is fixed; constants are not claimed uniform for growing q. The theorem concerns optimal likelihood ordering within syndrome classes and gives the leading exponential rate rather than optimized finite-length deviations or a computationally efficient ordering algorithm. Residual overlap risk remains with universal-hashing and task-encoding literature.
provenance: A collision-count analysis of likelihood ranks under random linear hashing, combined with Rényi guesswork bounds and a converse for arbitrary encoder cells.
record_title: Random linear syndromes attain the all-rate Renyi guesswork exponent
